chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Mihran, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdullah ibn Ibrahim ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, from al-Zayd ibn Sulayt, in a long tradition from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him)

That he said in the year in which he was taken (died): I will be taken in this year, and the authority (Amr) belongs to my son Ali, who is named after two Alis. As for the first Ali, it is Ali ibn Abi Talib, and as for the other Ali, it is Ali ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon them. He is given the understanding, forbearance, victory, love, and covenant of the first, and the tribulation of the other, and his patience for what he dislikes... The rest of the news.

key_terms.أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abu Ibrahim (Title of Imam Musa al-Kadim)
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ الْأَوَّلُ: The first Ali (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: Who is the 'Ali' designated as the successor of Imam Musa al-Kadim and what qualities does he inherit from previous Imams?
ai.summary: In the year of his death, Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) explicitly designated his son Ali ibn Musa (AS) as his successor, clarifying the dual naming convention to highlight the continuity of Imamate qualities. He attributed the intellectual depth, wisdom, and political support of Ali ibn Abi Talib to the first Ali, while linking the spiritual endurance and patience during tribulations characteristic of Ali ibn al-Husayn to the second. This designation underscores the theological principle of *Nass* (explicit designation) and the transmission of distinct spiritual and temporal virtues across generations.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 19 - It is narrated from Ahmad bin Mehran from Muhammad bin Ali from Ali bin Hakam from Abdullah bin Ibrahim bin Ali bin Abdullah bin Ja’far bin Abu Talib from Yazid bin Sulait in a long tradition on the authority of Abu Ibrahim, Musa (a.s)

that he said in the year in which he died: I will be taken in this year and the authority (Amr) will belong to son, Ali, who is named after two Alis. The first Ali is Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s) and the second Ali is Ali bin Husain, the blessings of God be on them. He (i.e. Ali Ridha) is given understanding, forbearance, knowledge, help, love, piety and religion of the first and tribulation and endurance in the face of adversity of the second.
